meta.source: L2J High Five datapack, github.com/Shagooh/l2j-server-datapack (main): quests/*.java, village_master/*.java, AbstractSagaQuest.java. Coordinates from Scripts/data/spawns_h5.json, levels from npcs_h5.json.
meta.server: L2Toggle (H5). Server-side changes are possible; verify the first run of each quest.
keyRules: 1st class quests: min level 18. Finishing at lvl 18 gives the most exp (591,724), 19 gives 456,128, 20+ gives 320,534. Class change itself needs lvl 20. Reward: 163,800 adena + quest item; the class master adds 15 Shadow Item Exchange Coupons (D-Grade).

2nd class: 3 marks (non-Kamael) or 1 certification quest (Kamael), lvl 40 for the change. The FIRST 2nd-class trial you accept gives a one-time Dimensional Diamond bonus (player variable 2ND_CLASS_DIAMOND_REWARD); amount depends on the quest and class. Accept the one with the biggest bonus first. Class master adds 15 Shadow Item Exchange Coupons (C-Grade).

3rd class (saga): lvl 76. Reward 2,299,404 exp, 5,000,000 adena, 1 Giant's Codex. Two solo-only kills; Halisha marks can be farmed in a party. Ice Crystal (7080) and Divine Stone of Wisdom (7081) are needed and are NOT sold by regular NPCs in the datapack.
Dimensional Diamonds can be traded at gatekeepers for Scrolls of Escape.
Shadow coupons: take them to a Grand Master of your class to exchange for Shadow weapons/armor.

turnIn.note: Hand in all 3 marks at lvl 40 -> Shillien Knight. Reward: 15 Shadow Item Exchange Coupons (C-Grade).
Hand in all 3 marks at lvl 40 -> Bishop. Reward: 15 Shadow Item Exchange Coupons (C-Grade).
Hand in all 3 marks at lvl 40 -> Destroyer. Reward: 15 Shadow Item Exchange Coupons (C-Grade).
Kamael Grand Master checks that quest 64 is completed -> Berserker. 15 C-grade Shadow coupons.

Inspector1.note: Inspector (135) is a SUBCLASS-only class. Main class plan: Trooper -> Soul Breaker -> Soul Hound (or Berserker -> Doombringer like Doombringer1). Retail H5 rule (not in this datapack, which only covers quests): a Kamael can take Inspector as a subclass after reaching lvl 75 on two other subclasses. Verify on L2Toggle.

turnIn.note: Kamael Grand Master checks that quest 65 is completed -> Male Soul Breaker. 15 C-grade Shadow coupons.
Hand in all 3 marks at lvl 40 -> Necromancer. Reward: 15 Shadow Item Exchange Coupons (C-Grade).
Hand in all 3 marks at lvl 40 -> Warcryer. Reward: 15 Shadow Item Exchange Coupons (C-Grade).
Hand in all 3 marks at lvl 40 -> Shillien Elder. Reward: 15 Shadow Item Exchange Coupons (C-Grade).
